question: Approximately how many hectares are targeted for increased forest and tree cover by 2030 as per the Revised Green India Mission (GIM) Plan released in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**24.7 million hectares**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Revised Green India Mission (GIM) Plan**, released in **2025**, aims to increase forest and tree cover by approximately **24.7 million hectares** by the year **2030**.
 
• The Green India Mission is one of the **eight missions** under the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), launched by the **Government of India** to address climate change challenges.
 
• The mission focuses on **ecosystem restoration**, **afforestation**, and **reforestation** in degraded forest lands and other areas, contributing to improved **carbon sequestration** and enhanced biodiversity.
 
• Under the revised plan, the mission has set ambitious targets to **restore degraded ecosystems**, improve the quality of forest cover, and enhance ecosystem services such as **water security**, **soil fertility**, and **livelihood generation**.
 
• It is part of India's commitment to achieving its **Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)** under the **Paris Agreement** to combat climate change through sustainable forest management and increased green cover.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Green India Mission (GIM):**

 
 
• GIM was launched in **2010** as part of the **National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC)**.
 
• Its primary objective is to increase the forest cover and improve ecosystem services such as **biodiversity conservation**, **water catchment protection**, and **carbon sequestration**.
 
• The mission emphasizes **community participation** in forest management and conservation efforts.
 
• It also focuses on enhancing the **livelihood opportunities** of forest-dependent communities through sustainable practices.
 
 
 
• **Paris Agreement and India's NDCs:**
 
 
• India's Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under the Paris Agreement aim to achieve a reduction in the **emissions intensity** of its GDP by **33-35%** by **2030**, compared to **2005** levels.
 
• The Green India Mission contributes to India's **land use and forestry** commitments by enhancing carbon sinks.
 
• India has pledged to create an additional **carbon sink of 2.5 to 3 billion tonnes** of CO₂ equivalent through increased forest and tree cover.
 
 
 
• **Global Context of Afforestation:**
 
 
• Afforestation and reforestation initiatives are critical components of global efforts to address **climate change** and achieve **sustainable development goals**.
 
• Organizations such as the **United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)** highlight the role of forests in **carbon sequestration** and mitigating climate change impacts.
 
• Countries worldwide are implementing similar programs to restore degraded lands and increase forest cover, aligning with international goals like the **Bonn Challenge** and **REDD+**.
 
 
 
• **Important Points:**
 
 
• India's forests serve as a critical resource for **carbon sequestration**, helping to mitigate the effects of **global warming**.
 
• Afforestation programs contribute to improving **soil fertility**, preventing **soil erosion**, and ensuring **water security** in forest-dependent regions.
 
• The Green India Mission promotes the adoption of **climate-resilient practices** in agricultural and forestry sectors, enhancing the sustainability of ecosystems.
 
• Increased green cover helps in conserving **native flora** and **fauna**, safeguarding India's rich biodiversity.
